text:
Write the work plan for Willow (modules: indexer, feed, session, notify, ingest, webhooks).

Fixed:
- notify: retry_limit exactly 4, timeout_s 90
- webhooks: ttl_s 510
- ingest: ttl_s 390 (client requirement), batch_size at least 800
- feed: max_workers at most 6

Ignore earlier drafts (notify timeout_s 15, webhooks ttl_s 330).

Constraints:
- feed must not depend on indexer, directly or indirectly
- session and ingest run on worker alpha
- session and webhooks never share a worker; feed and webhooks share one
- session depends on notify; ingest depends on session
- feed rolls out before session
- bench.py and client.py belong to session

Process: code review turnaround under one day; security review at month end.

Optional: session retry_limit around 5. Not required: notify on beta, linter choice, shared metrics library, naming, separate databases. Everything else is your call.
